newsitem.title: USA: Telecheck says Aug same-store spending up 3.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Telecheck says Aug same-store spending up 3.1 pct.

text.p: August same-store retail spending rose 3.1 percent over the same period last year, according to data compiled by TeleCheck Services Inc.
The check acceptance company said the figures reflect a rebound in spending following a weak performance in July, when same-store retail sales declined 2.4 percent.
The TeleCheck Retail Index showed that the Southwest led with a six percent gain, while both the Southeast and the Midwest rose 4.5 percent.
The West was up one percent, and the Northeast was down 1.4 percent, Telecheck said.
The index is based on a year-over-year, same-store comparison of the dollar volume of checks written by consumers at over 20,000 of TeleCheck's 160,000 subscribing locations.
